race.description: Toyota Forklifts Hot Danish Stakes F&M (G2)
race.comment: LAZZURA (1) won the G2 Golden Pendant over this track and trip two back, then was a month between runs with a decisive victory in the G2 The Invitation at Randwick over 1400m with the 59kg. Will stalk the speed and put these away quickly. GERRINGONG (3) strengthened up over the break for the Munce yard with a tough first up win in the G3 Nivison over 1200m here. Solid fourth over 1400m in the G2 The Invitation at Randwick. Can turn things around. TUILERIES (2) drawn off the track at her two runs this time in and finally comes up with a low draw. Snagged back to near last and like the way she closed late to run eighth in the G2 The Invitation at Randwick over 1400m. At her top for this and shapes as a genuine place contender. ARABIAN ROSE (4) caught the eye in the G3 Nivison here, then struck trouble at the start with a below par tenth in the G2 The Invitation over 1400m at Randwick. Key jockey change and can lift. CHAINS OF LOVE (8) stakes placed mare who deserves here chance here.
